audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Skill / Quinn / Quinn / Skill / Skill / Quinn / Quinn in both layers. The mirror set Quinn rows 0-2, Skill rows 3-5 and Wukong row 6, which is packet.levelChart exactly. Rows 0, 5 and 6 disagree.
audit.why: This page's own whys state the mirror's chart — whys[0] 'out-ranges your entire kit', whys[5] 'First item is even', whys[6] 'With two-plus items you win'. Three rows rendered a winner their own sentence contradicted.
audit.corrected: Flipped row 0 to Quinn, row 5 to Skill and row 6 to Wukong in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, with row 0's rating to 4/10 and row 6's to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heightened Senses appears nowhere on the page. It is a 50-second ability at rank 1 that reveals a large area at 2100 range, and passively grants her Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier-marked target.
audit.why: Two consequences the page never mentions. The passive half is the actual reason her trades ramp — the Harrier mark is not just bonus damage, it is what turns on her speed. And the active is a vision tool, which decides whether your bush plays and your jungler's approach work at all.
audit.corrected: Wrote the Harrier-into-Heightened-Senses ramp into the early spike and its 50s rank-1 cooldown and reveal into the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) spikes[1] says she will 'Vault away or Tag & Release' — Tag & Release is not an ability in this kit; her ultimate is BEHIND ENEMY LINES, an out-of-combat travel channel that ends in Skystrike. (b) The blind is attributed to Vault repeatedly — 'Vault (E) dashes off you and blinds you', 'Quinn wastes Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind)'. Vault does not blind. It is a 675-range dash on 12/11/10/9/8s that damages, SLOWS, BRIEFLY INTERRUPTS the target, and leaves her landing about an attack range away. The vision hinder is on Blinding Assault (Q), 1025 range, 11s at rank 1.
audit.why: The interrupt is the part that actually costs you the fight and it was never written down — Vault cuts your action short as she leaves, which is a different problem from being blinded. And separating the two cooldowns matters: her escape is on 12 seconds while her blind is on 11, so 'her E is down' does not mean you can walk through the blind.
audit.corrected: Removed the invented ultimate name, moved the blind to Blinding Assault, and described Vault as a dash that slows and briefly interrupts you before she lands at range. Real cooldowns and ranges added throughout.

notes: 'Tag & Release' is not an ability Quinn has — her ultimate is Behind Enemy Lines — and that invented name was sitting in the level 6 spike. The other structural fix is separating her two cooldowns: the page labelled Vault 'Dash/Blind' in three places, but the blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 1025, 11s) and Vault (E, 675, 12s) is a dash that slows and BRIEFLY INTERRUPTS you before dropping her back at attack range. The interrupt was never mentioned and it is what cuts your commit short. Heightened Senses was absent entirely, including the fact that hitting a Harrier mark is what turns on her attack and move speed. Not asserted because the data cannot settle it: whether Heightened Senses' reveal defeats Warrior Trickster's invisibility (the mirror flagged the same open question), and whether Vault's interrupt can cancel Cyclone mid-channel.
